title: Battle of Lacolle Mills (1814)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Lacolle Mills (1814)", at revision 1370446894, opens: "The Battle of Lacolle Mills was fought on 30 March 1814 during the War of 1812. The small garrison of a British outpost position, aided by Canadian reinforcements, fought off a large American attack." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q233356, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle on 30 March 1814 during the War of 1812". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
